page_title: NEW 5-0 CRY | Newcastle v Crystal Palace 16/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Darren England had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+2' CLOSE! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
90+2' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Nick Pope stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

88' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
87' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
85' Here's the change. Jefferson Lerma leaves the pitch and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
85' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) tries to find Tyrick Mitchell with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
81' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Nick Pope has no trouble gathering it.
79' That's the end of the game for Kieran Trippier, who is replaced by Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd).
78' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Ismaila Sarr and he is replaced by Romain Esse (Crystal Palace).
75' 5:3 – the corner kicks stats.
72' Jason Tindall has decided to make a change. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Isak.
70' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
70' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

69' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
69' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) launches a cross from the corner, but Nick Pope is alert to thwart the effort.
64' The only thing Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) had to do was not to hit his teammate with his header from the six-yard box. That he didn't manage and thus wasted an obvious opportunity.
62' Jason Tindall prepares a substitution. Jacob Murphy is replaced by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
62' Substitution. Joelinton is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
61' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
60' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
60' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) was probably a bit loose with his words to Darren England, who decides to show him a yellow.
58' 5 - 0 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is teed up on the edge of the box by Joelinton, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 5:0.
57' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Will Hughes will be replaced by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace).
57' Substitution. Eberechi Eze did his best and is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
56' The substitution is prepared. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jean-Philippe Mateta.
55' Some great controlled play and passing from Newcastle. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
51' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
50' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
48' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a chip pass into the box, but Dean Henderson is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+9' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+8' 4 - 0 Jacob Murphy showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 4:0.

45+8' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Newcastle, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45+6' Nick Pope leaps to intercept the corner kick from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
45+6' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the box.
45+5' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) but poses no threat.
45+3' 3 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) was set free in the area by Sandro Tonali and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

42' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
40' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Nick Pope.
38' 2 - 0 What bad luck! Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 2:0.

36' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Nick Pope to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
36' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is going to take the penalty!
35' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Crystal Palace!

32' Play continues despite the shouts by some Crystal Palace players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Darren England interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
32' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
32' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

31' The ball rebounds to Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) around the penalty spot and he produces a header towards the goal. Unfortunately for him, one of the defenders prevents the ball from ending in the net.
29' Darren England blows his whistle and it's Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
29' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
28' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd), but the defence gets it clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.
28' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
27' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Newcastle have been awarded a free kick.
26' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
24' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
24' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

22' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
21' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

21' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
21' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
19' The foul by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
14' 1 - 0 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from mid range.
13' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) has time in the box after a cross from Daniel Munoz, but places his shot well wide of the right post.
13' A pass from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.
12' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Harvey Barnes, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.

10' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
9' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
9' The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.

9' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace.

8' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
5' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Nick Pope comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

4' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Dean Henderson!
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

1' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
Darren England is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
